classification.difficultyReason: Choose a rectangle condition to test, calculate adjacent-side gradients and recognise that their product differing from −1 is sufficient to reject the rectangle without testing every side.

content.prompt: Determine whether the points $A(-6,-3)$, $B(3,-8)$, $C(8,-1)$ and $D(-2,5)$ form a rectangle or not.

answer.short: No. The adjacent sides $AB$ and $BC$ are not perpendicular.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}m_{AB}&=\frac{-8-(-3)}{3-(-6)}\\m_{AB}&=-\frac59\\m_{BC}&=\frac{-1-(-8)}{8-3}\\m_{BC}&=\frac75\\m_{AB}m_{BC}&=-\frac79\ne-1\end{align*}$$The adjacent sides $AB$ and $BC$ are not perpendicular, so $ABCD$ is not a rectangle.
